items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 84:1
items.html: When ZA also includes the small Jacob, then he is entirely Mah. And the Nukva of ZA includes the small Rachel, then she is entirely Ban. Therefore they are considered separate. (Inner Light, p. 664, entry "And this")
